note: Practical priors about bowfishing are hypotheses until validated on field data; fit-for-purpose targets are pre-declared requirements, not achievements.
role: Surface water temperature and its uncertainty
bowfishingPurpose: Temperature drives fish activity and spawning: carp, buffalo and gar move into the shallows to spawn inside species-specific temperature bands, and cold water slows them; the rules use bands only a few degrees wide, so an error of 2 C changes the answer.
decisionsInformed: are fish likely active in the shallows

predicts.desc: Honest error range around the estimate

needsFrom.why: reservoir size modulates warming and cooling

fitForPurpose.rationale: species rules use 2-4 C bands, so error should be at most about half a band
a stated 80% range must contain the truth about 80% of the time

priorityQuestions: Is the seasonal bias of M0 correctable across lakes?
Is the published uncertainty band calibrated on lakes it was not fitted on?
abstainWhen: sensor and model disagree beyond 3 C
